Name: ClearMove
Description:
The idea for ClearMove came about after my great-aunt passed away at the age of 93 and my family were faced with the clearance of her much-loved home. At the same time, my siblings and I were helping our parents to downsize, and it became apparent to me that there was a need for someone to step in to help support and streamline the process and take the stress away from those who were emotionally involved in the moves.

This is when I established my business ClearMove. 

ClearMove provides assistance to people moving or clearing a home, from furniture clearance and move co-ordination right through to setting up utility providers in the clients new home. 

My role is, to co-ordinate and direct the different elements of the process into a smooth transition. I can provide a partial or full service for clients as required, starting with an initial free phone consultation.

The next step is to provide clients with a plan of action, which gives them the tools and contacts to continue with the house move & clearance themselves or I can source and manage the services and suppliers needed.

My aim is to look at saving people time and money and minimise the pressure and stress.

From managing quotes to scheduling appointments, I ensure that all activities are coordinated according to individual circumstances and schedule. I arrange valuations, removals vans, and look to re-home items no longer wanted through either selling or donating. Limiting what needs to go into a skip.

Since establishing my business I have uncovered several pieces of interest of which some were valued into the 1000s. It’s always worth that extra time to get antique items valued. You just never know what you might have.

ClearMove is about helping people. Moving or clearing a home is possibly one of the most stressful things people can do, especially if they have been there generations or 40/50 years.

People turn to professionals in other important decisions in their lives, moving should be the same.

Name: ReBild.life
Description:
Small local communities will have to recover and rebuild themselves after this crisis, as they always do. Challenges will be very local and will need practical solutions which Internet, oddly, does not provide.

ReBild.life is a non-profit platform that supports active members of local communities who want to participate in the rebuilding process with practical and usually simple solutions - Called "Bilds".

ReBild.life brings to members of local communities:

Workable Solutions - Local leaders find and use working solutions - Bilds from other local communities and implement them locally.
Connected Community - Users connect with authors of Bilds and receive support and news about all solutions and ideas from the author's community.
Helping the World - Users can author and share their projects via the most effective channel to help 100s communities all over the world.

Categories of Challenges Addressed by ReBild.life:
Community, Well-being, Family, Animals, Education, Culture, Environment, Employment, Economy, Transport and Others


Why the ReBild platform?

With the crisis, the sense of community and the desire to help each other during these difficult times increased. If you have experience from your career which you know should be somehow helpful, you wonder where and in what form it could be applied.

For local communities, when responding to current circumstances becoming the new normal, it is surprisingly difficult to find practical solutions, particularly, how to stay connected and to rebuild their life. Neither the government nor the Internet almighty help with the new challenges to come. Especially the Internet, being full of articles, ideas and stories, disappoints with almost none of them being directly applicable in real-life. 

So, we started a platform where anyone can share their knowledge coming from locally implemented projects, described in an actionable way and make it globally available for other committed members to implement.

Name: VerumCAST
Description:
VerumCast is a verifiable media infrastructure that enables public figures, organisations, and institutions to publish communications with provable origin.

The system establishes a cryptographic link between a piece of content and its source, allowing any recipient to independently validate authenticity, authorship, and integrity without reliance on intermediaries.

In an environment where synthetic media, misattribution, and unauthorised replication are on the rise, VerumCast addresses a structural gap: the absence of a native verification layer for public communication.

VerumCast does not attempt to determine truth. It establishes provenance.

Content is voluntarily submitted by rights holders and anchored through a verifiable framework that produces an immutable reference point. From this, external systems, platforms, and audiences can distinguish authenticated signals from unverified or manipulated content.

The platform provides:

• Verifiable origin and authorship for digital communications
• Tamper-evident anchoring and metadata integrity
• Detection surfaces for unauthorised use and potential exposure
• Evidence-grade outputs suitable for legal, regulatory, and institutional contexts

VerumCast is designed to operate across media, enterprise communications, public sector messaging, and high-risk information environments where attribution and integrity are critical.

It is not a publishing platform. It is an integrity layer.

Doubt ends here.

Name: RippleXn
Description:
What is this https://github.com/octree-labs/octree


The GitHub repo you sent —
 https://github.com/octree-labs/octree — is an open-source AI LaTeX editor, essentially a modern alternative to Overleaf for writing technical papers, research documents, and mathematical content. 

What Octree (the project) actually is

Octree is a tool for writing and editing LaTeX documents with AI assistance.

LaTeX is the formatting language used by:

academics

scientists

mathematicians

engineers

research labs

to write things like:

research papers

technical reports

equations-heavy documents

academic theses

The Octree project tries to make that easier by combining:

a LaTeX editor

AI writing assistance

document tooling like TikZ diagrams, BibTeX references, and equation editing. 

In simple terms:

Octree = AI-powered Overleaf replacement.

What’s actually inside the repo

From the repo structure and related repos, it includes things like:

AI-assisted text editing for LaTeX

tools for math equation conversion (image → LaTeX)

templates for academic writing

a deployable web interface (often deployable on Vercel) 

So developers can:

self-host it

extend it

build tools for research writing

Why people build tools like this

Academic workflows are painful:

ProblemOctree tries to solveLaTeX is powerful but hardAI helps generate/edit LaTeXOverleaf is SaaS onlyopen-source alternativeMath typing is slowimage → equation conversionCitation management messyintegrated BibTeX tools

Important: the name “Octree”

The name Octree comes from a computer-science concept:

An octree is a data structure that splits 3-D space into eight parts recursively (like a cube subdividing into smaller cubes). 

But in this project it’s mostly just a brand name, not necessarily the core algorithm.

Would this be useful for you?

Probably not directly for RippleXn, because it’s focused on academic document writing, not:

intelligence pipelines

vector search

timelines

signal ingestion

Name: Article 27 Representation
Description:
Article 27 Representation provides peace of mind to organisations controlling and processing data across borders between the UK and Europe; and the rest of the world. 
From our final departure from the EU the UK will become as a 'third country' for data privacy purposes, with no equivalence or adequacy guaranteed.
 
At the same time, the UK will have its own amended version of GDPR, enacted under the terms of The Data Protection, Privacy and Electronic Communications (Amendments etc) (EU Exit) Regulations 2019, making the EU will become a 'third country' to us for data protection purposes.

Organisations monitoring the behaviours of data subjects, or providing goods and services into the UK from Europe; or from Europe into the UK, that do not have a physical presence in the other jurisdiction will need to have representation in line with Article 27 of the General Data Protection Regulations. Failure to do so will expose UK organisations to fines of up to the greater of 2% of global turnover, or €10m; whilst European and other 'third country' organisations will be open to similar sized fines for non-compliance within the UK. 
But the impact of Brexit doesn't stop there: in the event of a data breach, organisations who are headquartered in one of the jurisdictions, but are also collecting, controlling and/or processing personal data of subjects in the other could find themselves exposed to investigation and fines from regulators in BOTH the EU and the UK; doubling the maximum fines to the equivalent of 8% or global turnover or €40m! 
To mitigate this risk Article 27 Representation provides a presence in both jurisdictions, allowing organisations to continue to operate with minimal disruption and peace of mind in knowing that not only are you complying with both sets of regulations, but that you have someone there to represent your organisation’s interests. 
For more information about how we can help contact: enquiries@article27representation.co.uk
